b2-ma.title: Negation: Ma + Verb, Mish + Noun
b2-ma.explanation: ما (ma) negates a present-tense verb directly: ما بشوف البيت اليوم (ma bshuf el-beit el-yom, "I'm not seeing the house today"). مش (mish) negates a noun, adjective, or nominal sentence instead: مش منيح (mish mnih, "not good") -- verbs take ما, everything else takes مش.
b2-ma.fact: In fast, casual Damascus/Aleppo speech, ما often gets pronounced almost as a quick nasal hum fused onto the verb -- so "ما بعرف" can sound closer to "mabaaraf" than two separate words, even though it's written as two.

items.translit: saba7 el-kheir ya sadeeq, kiifak? mnih wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: عندي عيلة منيحة، وعندي كتاب جديد كمان
items.en: I have a good family, and I have a new book too
items.translit: 3andi 3eele mniha, wa 3andi ktaab jdeed kaman

items.ar: البيت الجديد قريب من البحر، والمدينة قريبة كمان
items.en: The new house is near the sea, and the city is nearby too
items.translit: el-beit ej-jdeed 2areeb min el-ba7er, wal-madiine 2areebe kaman

items.ar: مافي مشكلة، عيلتي منيحة والحمدلله يا صديق، شكراً كتير
items.en: No problem, my family is good, thank God, friend, thank you very much
items.translit: mafi mushkile, 3eelti mniha wal-hamdulillah ya sadeeq

items.ar: عيلتي منيحة لأن عندنا بنك قريب وتكسي منيح
items.en: My family is good because we have a nearby bank and a good taxi
items.translit: 3eelti mniha la2an 3andna bank 2areeb wa taksi mnih

items.ar: ابني منيح لأن عنده كتاب جديد وقط صغير كمان
items.en: My son is good because he has a new book and a small cat too
items.translit: ibni mnih la2an 3ando ktaab jdeed wa 2it sgheer kaman

items.ar: زوجي منيح لأن شاف مدينة قريبة مع أهله
items.en: My husband is good because he saw a nearby city with his family
items.translit: zawji mnih la2an shaf madiine 2areebe ma3 aahlo

items.ar: عندنا مصاري كتير عشان شفنا بنك جديد قريب
items.en: We have a lot of money because we saw a new nearby bank
items.translit: 3andna masaari ktir 3ashan shifna bank jdeed 2areeb

items.ar: بشوف عيلتي وزوجتي وابني، منيحين كتير والحمدلله
items.en: I see my family, my wife, and my son, very good, thank God
items.translit: bshuf 3eelti wa zawjti wa ibni, mnihin ktir wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: ما بيحب البنك الغالي، بيحب التكسي الرخيص كمان
items.en: He doesn't love the expensive bank, he loves the cheap taxi too
items.translit: ma byhib el-bank el-ghali, byhib et-taksi er-rkhees kaman

items.ar: ما بتشوفي المدينة اليوم، بتشوفي البحر والنهر بكرة
items.en: You don't see the city today, you see the sea and the river tomorrow
items.translit: ma btshufi el-madiine el-yom, btshufi el-ba7er wan-nahr bukra

items.ar: ما منحب الشغلة البعيدة، منحب شغلة عيلتنا القريبة كتير
items.en: We don't love the far matter, we love our family's nearby matter a lot
items.translit: ma mnhib esh-shaghle el-ba3eede, mnhib shaghlet 3eeltna el-2areebe ktir

items.ar: عيلتي وزوجي وابني منيحين، والحمدلله كتير منيح
items.en: My family, my husband, and my son are good, thank God, very good
items.translit: 3eelti wa zawji wa ibni mnihin, wal-hamdulillah ktir mnih

items.ar: شفت كتاب ومدينة وبحر مبارح، منيح كتير والحمدلله
items.en: I saw a book, a city, and a sea yesterday, very good, thank God
items.translit: shift ktaab wa madiine wa ba7er mbari7, mnih ktir wal-hamdulillah

items.ar: ما بتحب البنك الغالي، بتحب التكسي القريب من بيتك
items.en: You don't love the expensive bank, you love the taxi near your house
items.translit: ma bthib el-bank el-ghali, bthib et-taksi el-2areeb min beitek

items.ar: ما منحب الشغلة البعيدة، منحب عيلتنا ومصارينا القريبة كتير
items.en: We don't love the far matter, we love our family and our nearby money a lot
items.translit: ma mnhib esh-shaghle el-ba3eede, mnhib 3eeltna wa masaarina el-2areebe ktir

lessons.title: My Uncle Comes Every Friday
lessons.context: A passage about a family visit.

paragraphs.ar: عمي بيجي بيتنا الجمعة، ومعه خالتي.
paragraphs.en: My uncle comes to our house on Friday, and my aunt is with him.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بيجوا بكرة، منشوف تيتتي كمان.
paragraphs.en: If they come tomorrow, we'll see my grandmother too.

paragraphs.ar: خيي بيحب يشوف عمي، لأنه منيح كتير معه.
paragraphs.en: My brother loves to see my uncle, because he's very good to him.

paragraphs.ar: إختي بتحب تيتتي كتير، عشان هي منيحة كتير.
paragraphs.en: My sister loves my grandmother a lot, because she's very good.

paragraphs.ar: عيلتنا بتجي بيتنا يوم الجمعة، والحمدلله.
paragraphs.en: Our family comes to our house on Friday, thank God.

questions.question: When does the uncle come?
Who is with him?
Why does the brother love to see the uncle?
Who does the sister love?

lessons.title: A Poor Friend, A Rich Uncle
lessons.context: A passage contrasting rich and poor.

paragraphs.ar: صديقي فقير، بس هو منيح كتير معي.
paragraphs.en: My friend is poor, but he's very good to me.

paragraphs.ar: عمي غني كتير، وعنده بيت غالي قريب من البحر.
paragraphs.en: My uncle is very rich, and he has an expensive house close to the sea.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بيجي صديقي بيتنا، عمي بيحب يشوفه كتير.
paragraphs.en: If my friend comes to our house, my uncle loves to see him a lot.

paragraphs.ar: صديقي مش زعلان عشان هو فقير، هو منيح ومنيح.
paragraphs.en: My friend isn't upset because he's poor, he's good.

paragraphs.ar: عمي بيحب صديقي الفقير كتير، مش بس فلوسه.
paragraphs.en: My uncle loves my poor friend a lot, not just his money.

questions.question: How is the friend described financially?
What does the uncle have?
options: A cheap house far from the sea
An expensive house close to the sea

questions.question: Who loves to see the friend?
What does the uncle love more than his money?

lessons.title: If My Family Comes
lessons.context: A passage using conditionals with family.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بتجي عيلتي بكرة، منجي البحر سوا.
paragraphs.en: If my family comes tomorrow, we'll come to the sea together.

paragraphs.ar: خالي وعمي بيحبو البحر كتير، ودايما بيجوا معنا.
paragraphs.en: My uncle and my uncle love the sea a lot, and they always come with us.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بتحبي تشوفي تيتتي، لازم بتجي بيتنا يوم الجمعة.
paragraphs.en: If you love to see my grandmother, you must come to our house on Friday.

paragraphs.ar: إختي مبارح شافت خالتي، وهني منيحين كتير سوا.
paragraphs.en: My sister saw my aunt yesterday, and they're very good together.

paragraphs.ar: عيلتي منيحة كتير، وإذا بتجي معنا، بتشوف قرايبنا.
paragraphs.en: My family is very good, and if you come with us, you'll see our relatives.

questions.question: Where will they go if the family comes tomorrow?
What do the uncles love?
When must you come to see the grandmother?
Who did the sister see yesterday?

lessons.title: Every Friday We Come Together
lessons.context: A passage about a weekly family tradition.

paragraphs.ar: الجمعة، عيلتنا بتجي بيت جدو.
paragraphs.en: On Friday, our family comes to grandpa's house.

paragraphs.ar: جدو منيح كتير، وبيحب يشوف حفيده.
paragraphs.en: Grandpa is very good, and he loves to see his grandson.

paragraphs.ar: عمي وخالي بيجوا مع ولادهم، وهني منيحين كتير.
paragraphs.en: My uncle and my uncle come with their sons, and they're very good.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بيحب يشوف عيلتنا، لازم بيجي يوم الجمعة.
paragraphs.en: If he loves to see our family, he must come on Friday.

paragraphs.ar: منيح كتير! منحب هاد اليوم، والحمدلله.
paragraphs.en: Very good! We love this day, thank God.

questions.question: When does the family come to grandpa's house?
Who does grandpa love to see?
Who do the uncles come with?
When must he come to see the family?

lessons.title: Complete: B2 Reading Wrap One
lessons.context: A review passage combining family, colors, and conditionals.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بيجي خالي بكرة، منشوف بيته الأخضر سوا.
paragraphs.en: If my uncle comes tomorrow, we'll see his green house together.

paragraphs.ar: صديقي الأحسن دايما بيجي معي، وبيحب أهلي كتير.
paragraphs.en: My best friend always comes with me, and he loves my family a lot.

paragraphs.ar: إختي منيحة كتير معي، وهي بتحب تيتتنا كتير.
paragraphs.en: My sister is very good to me, and she loves our grandmother a lot.

paragraphs.ar: عيلتنا منيحة كتير، عندنا بيت أحمر وبيت أخضر.
paragraphs.en: Our family is very good, we have a red house and a green house.

paragraphs.ar: شكرا كتير، بكرة منشوف عيلتنا سوا.
paragraphs.en: Thank you very much, tomorrow we'll see our family together.

questions.question: What color house will they see if the uncle comes?
Who always comes with the speaker?
Who does the sister love most?
What colors are their houses?

lessons.title: How Much Is This House?
lessons.context: A passage about buying a house.

paragraphs.ar: قديش هاد البيت؟ هاد البيت غالي كتير.
paragraphs.en: How much is this house? This house is very expensive.

paragraphs.ar: وهاي السيارة؟ هاي رخيصة كتير، وهي منيحة.
paragraphs.en: And this car? This is very cheap, and it's good.

paragraphs.ar: صديقي بياخد البيت الغالي، وأنا باخد السيارة الرخيصة.
paragraphs.en: My friend takes the expensive house, and I take the cheap car.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بتخلصي فلوسك اليوم، بتاخدي البيت الأحسن.
paragraphs.en: If you finish your money today, you take the best house.

paragraphs.ar: منيح! منخلص هلق، ماشي حالنا.
paragraphs.en: Good! We finish now, we're fine.

questions.question: How is the house described?
How is the car described?
What does the friend take?
What do you take if you finish your money today?

lessons.title: He's Late, But Certain
lessons.context: A passage about waiting for someone.

paragraphs.ar: صديقي متأخر كتير اليوم، بس مؤكد بيجي.
paragraphs.en: My friend is very late today, but he's certainly coming.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بيجي متأخر، منشوف هاد الكتاب سوا.
paragraphs.en: If he comes late, we'll see this book together.

paragraphs.ar: هاي القصة منيحة كتير، وهي أحسن من هاد الكتاب.
paragraphs.en: This story is very good, and it's better than this book.

paragraphs.ar: عمي مؤكد بيحب هاي القصة، بيحب يشوفها هلق.
paragraphs.en: My uncle certainly loves this story, he loves to see it now.

paragraphs.ar: منيح! صديقي بيجي هلق، ماشي حاله.
paragraphs.en: Good! My friend is coming now, he's fine.

questions.question: How is the friend today?
What will they see together if he's late?
How is the story compared to the book?
What does the uncle certainly love?

lessons.title: Taking and Finishing
lessons.context: A passage using the new verbs 'take' and 'finish'.

paragraphs.ar: باخد كتابي، وبخلص شغلتي هلق.
paragraphs.en: I take my book, and I finish my matter now.

paragraphs.ar: صديقي بياخد سيارته، وبيخلص شغلته بكرة.
paragraphs.en: My friend takes his car, and he finishes his matter tomorrow.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بتاخدي وقتك، بتخلصي شغلتك منيح.
paragraphs.en: If you take your time, you finish your matter well.

paragraphs.ar: منجي بيتك، ومناخد قهوتنا سوا.
paragraphs.en: We come to your house, and we take our coffee together.

paragraphs.ar: منيح كتير! منخلص هلق، والحمدلله.
paragraphs.en: Very good! We finish now, thank God.

questions.question: What does the speaker take?
What does the friend take?
What happens if you take your time?
What do they take together at the listener's house?

lessons.title: This Is the Best Book
lessons.context: A review passage using demonstratives and 'better'.

paragraphs.ar: هاد الكتاب أحسن من هاي القصة، بس هيدي منيحة كتير كمان.
paragraphs.en: This book is better than this story, but this one is also very good.

paragraphs.ar: قديش هاد الكتاب؟ هو رخيص كتير اليوم.
paragraphs.en: How much is this book? It's very cheap today.

paragraphs.ar: صديقي باخد هيدا الكتاب، وأنا باخد هاي القصة.
paragraphs.en: My friend takes this book, and I take this story.

paragraphs.ar: مؤكد هاد اليوم منيح كتير، وماشي حالنا.
paragraphs.en: This day is certainly very good, and we're fine.

paragraphs.ar: منيح! منخلص هلق، شكرا كتير.
paragraphs.en: Good! We finish now, thank you very much.

questions.question: How is the book compared to the story?
How is the book described today?
What does the friend take?
How is the day described?

lessons.context: A final review passage for this batch.

paragraphs.ar: قديش هاد البيت؟ هو غالي كتير.
paragraphs.en: How much is this house? It's very expensive.

paragraphs.ar: صديقي متأخر، بس مؤكد بيجي هلق.
paragraphs.en: My friend is late, but he's certainly coming now.

paragraphs.ar: باخد كتابي الأحسن، وبخلص شغلتي بكرة.
paragraphs.en: I take my best book, and I finish my matter tomorrow.

paragraphs.ar: هاي القصة منيحة كتير، وهي أحسن من هاد الكتاب.
paragraphs.en: This story is very good, and it's better than this book.

paragraphs.ar: منيح كتير! منخلص هلق، ماشي حالنا.
paragraphs.en: Very good! We finish now, we're fine.

lessons.title: A Cat by the River
lessons.context: A short story about a cat and a river.

paragraphs.ar: عندنا قط منيح، وهو بيحب النهر كتير.
paragraphs.en: We have a good cat, and it loves the river a lot.

paragraphs.ar: مبارح شفنا القط قريب من النهر، وهو منيح كتير.
paragraphs.en: Yesterday we saw the cat close to the river, and it's very good.

paragraphs.ar: صديقي بيحب القط الغالي، وأنا بحب القط الرخيص.
paragraphs.en: My friend loves the expensive cat, and I love the cheap cat.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بيجي القط بيتنا بكرة، منشوفه سوا.
paragraphs.en: If the cat comes to our house tomorrow, we'll see it together.

paragraphs.ar: منيح كتير! القط منيح، والنهر منيح، والحمدلله.
paragraphs.en: Very good! The cat is good, and the river is good, thank God.

questions.question: What does the cat love?
Where did they see the cat yesterday?
Which cat does the friend love?
When will they see the cat if it comes?

lessons.title: The Bank and the Money
lessons.context: A passage about the bank and money.

paragraphs.ar: صديقي بيجي البنك، عشان عنده فلوس كتير.
paragraphs.en: My friend comes to the bank, because he has a lot of money.

paragraphs.ar: أنا فقير شوي، بس منيح كتير.
paragraphs.en: I'm a little poor, but very good.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بيجي صديقي البنك، بياخد فلوسه وبيخلص شغلته.
paragraphs.en: If my friend comes to the bank, he takes his money and finishes his matter.

paragraphs.ar: عمي غني كتير، وعنده فلوس كتير.
paragraphs.en: My uncle is very rich, and he has a lot of money.

paragraphs.ar: منيح! البنك قريب من بيتنا، والحمدلله.
paragraphs.en: Good! The bank is close to our house, thank God.

questions.question: Why does the friend come to the bank?
options: He has a lot of money

questions.question: How is the speaker described?
What does the friend do at the bank?
options: Takes his money and finishes his matter

lessons.title: A Story About a Sword
lessons.context: A short story with an old sword.

paragraphs.ar: عندي سيف قديم، وهو غالي كتير.
paragraphs.en: I have an old sword, and it's very expensive.

paragraphs.ar: صديقي بيحب هاد السيف، وبيحب بياخده.
paragraphs.en: My friend loves this sword, and he loves taking it.

paragraphs.ar: هاي القصة منيحة كتير، وهي أحسن من هاد الكتاب.
paragraphs.en: This story is very good, and it's better than this book.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بيحب يشوف السيف، لازم بيجي بيتي.
paragraphs.en: If he loves to see the sword, he must come to my house.

paragraphs.ar: منيح كتير! السيف منيح، والقصة منيحة، والحمدلله.
paragraphs.en: Very good! The sword is good, and the story is good, thank God.

questions.question: What does the speaker have?
What does the friend love to do?
How is the story compared to the book?
What must he do to see the sword?

lessons.title: Rich and Poor Together
lessons.context: A review passage about friendship across wealth.

paragraphs.ar: صديقي غني، وأنا فقير، بس نحنا منيحين سوا.
paragraphs.en: My friend is rich, and I'm poor, but we're good together.

paragraphs.ar: هو عنده بيت غالي، وأنا عندي بيت رخيص.
paragraphs.en: He has an expensive house, and I have a cheap house.

paragraphs.ar: إذا بيجي بيتي، بيحب يشوف كتابي وسيفي.
paragraphs.en: If he comes to my house, he loves to see my book and my sword.

paragraphs.ar: أنا بحب بيته الغالي، وهو بيحب بيتي الرخيص.
paragraphs.en: I love his expensive house, and he loves my cheap house.

paragraphs.ar: منيح كتير! نحنا سوا، والحمدلله.
paragraphs.en: Very good! We're together, thank God.
